Export.//: Unguessable token gating the anonymous Skylight ICS feed (/feed/{token}/chores.ics).
Export.//FeedToken: Leave empty here. Set out of band: 'dotnet user-secrets set Export:FeedToken <value>' in dev, or an App Service application setting named 'Export__FeedToken' in prod. While empty the feed is disabled (404). Never commit a real value.
Export.//FeedCacheSeconds: Server-side output cache for the anonymous ICS feed. Skylight polls on its own schedule; without this every poll would query Azure SQL and keep the serverless database from ever auto-pausing (a continuous cost). Assignments change at most once a month, so an hour is conservative.
